cards.name: Vir Pedicae Mortis - Entity's Happy Servant

coverage_override.reason: The Summoned search effect with alternative cost and the conditional destruction-protection field effect are two effects.

effects.printed_clause: If Summoned: discard 1 or send a controlled Recollection to the GY; add a Recollection and Bear Trap or a Mortis card from the Deck. HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Normal/Special trigger clones share a hard limit and offer the two legal costs. Resolution adds one Recollection plus Bear Trap or a card whose code belongs to the generated standalone-Mortis name pool. That pool is rebuilt from official Omega/local names and includes the four Vir Pedicae Mortis monsters and Teleum Mortis.

official_references.matched_structure: Uses exact/listed name relationships to implement a printed-name-dependent Deck search rather than substituting an archetype set.

effects.issue: Fixed: the second search pool now follows the printed word Mortis literally, including Teleum Mortis, instead of approximating it with the Vir Pedicae Mortis set code.

effects.printed_clause: While controlling Pedicae's Papa, Recollection cards and Mine Field Spells you control cannot be destroyed by opponent effects.
effects.lua_implementation: A field indestructibility effect checks for face-up Papa and protects face-up Recollection cards or Field Spells in the generated standalone-Mine name pool from opponent-caused effect destruction. The pool currently contains Mystic Mine and Recollection: the Mine.

official_references.matched_structure: Applies opponent-effect destruction protection to a filtered class of cards.
Provides the official Omega identity/type of an official Mine-named Field Spell included by the corrected pool.

effects.issue: Fixed: protection now includes all current Mine-named Field Spells, including official Mystic Mine, through the generated name pool.
